site_name: Waitrose 2 Alexandria RoadWest EalingW13 0NL
description: Minor Material Amendment (S.73) to vary conditions 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Quantum of Development), 25 (Landscaping), 31 (Car Parking) and 43 (Fire Strategy) pursuant to planning permission reference 233076FUL dated 27/04/2025 for 'Demolition of existing buildings and structures and the phased erection of buildings for mixed-use scheme, including new homes; a replacement food store; Flexible Commercial Space; alterations to the existing access road; associated improvements to streets, open spaces, landscaping and public realm; and provision of car and bicycle parking spaces and servicing spaces and other works incidental to the proposed development'. Variation seeks to provide amended drawings in respect of design amendments to internal and external layout, relocation of store service yard, reduction in link blocks building heights and apartment floor to ceiling heights, changes to façade, fenestration, landscaping and amenity space, car and cycle parking, quantum of retail and residential floorspace, to provide 37 additional homes, relocation of Café and revision of store entrance, including new second entrance
